entry.author: Oranga Tamariki
entry.summary:
This video talks about the rights of tamariki and rangatahi in care. This includes living somewhere safe, having a say in everything that is about you, having contact with your whānau, hapū and iwi, your right to a social worker, your right to privacy and confidentiality, having a plan, your right to have access to an advocate, and your rights as tamariki Māori.  
 
Oranga Tamariki has an obligation to ensure that all tamariki in care are informed of their rights.
